name: Poly Cubed at Pomona 2025
information:
The incredible sequel to 2018's hit competition, Poly^3 @ Pomona 2025 will have more competitors, more cubes, and more fun!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PolyCubedatPomona2025/#64691-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

All attendees under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
